title: metadata-protocol: the history diff door compares two package holders' versions of one name as if they were one item's (ADR-0150 D4, after #32905)
body:
epic:#31527#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvyhxPWfA8DsbmVYJ5

Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named landing point and a measured wrong answer over HTTP, owed by PR #33193 (#32905), which scoped it out.

Parent: #32905 (source card). Found by: the measurement on #32905 (step 1, section A) and contract review 6880527562 on PR #33193 ("Follow-ups without a card … need a card before merge").

- **Why:** an admin comparing two versions of a flow, agent or other per-package item that two packages hold gets a diff of one package's version against the other package's version, presented as one item's change. They read it to decide what a rollback will restore, so a wrong diff leads them to restore the wrong body. PR #33193 makes history and rollback answer per holder (`?package=`, bare 409); the diff door is the last door of the family that still reads across holders.
- **Reader:** the server lane's next seat on the epic #31527 line, after PR #33193 lands.
- **Duplicate search** (issues, open and closed, 2026-11-14): `is:issue diff history package holders` 139 hits, `is:issue getHistory package` 18, `is:issue history rollback action two shippers` 2. The only open hits on this surface are #32905 (the source card), #31699 and #31527 (the epic); #32351 (closed) made the manager path package-aware and #23658 (closed) is the publish twin of item B. None covers this item.

## Measured (reach: HTTP)

Showcase boot (`bootShowcase`, `packages/qa/dogfood`) at `47f6c939`, two packages `com.qa.hist.alpha` and `com.qa.hist.beta` each shipping flow `qa_hist_shared`, each edited twice in its writable pair (versions 1 and 3 alpha's, 2 and 4 beta's):

| Request | Status | Answer |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/flow/qa_hist_shared/diff?from=1&to=2` | 200 | alpha's v1 diffed against beta's v2, as if one item's versions |

It writes nothing, so it is not a data-loss defect, but the answer is wrong.

## Landing point

`diffMetaItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`) reads `sys_metadata_history` by `(type, name)`. The door (`GET /meta/:type/:name/diff`, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`) takes no `package`.

## Expected

The same rule PR #33193 gives history and rollback (`historySlotOf`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-slots.ts`): `?package=P` diffs only the addressed slot's versions and refuses a version another holder owns; a bare request for a name two slots hold answers 409 naming both; a one-holder name keeps working bare; `?package=` on a type not stored per package answers 400. The console's diff view (if it calls the door) names the package where it names it for history.
